title: A spotlight draws the border, shadow and blur it is given round its lit area
goal: A person who adds a Border, Shadow or Blur to a spotlight in the Effects section sees nothing happen. A border should ring the lit area (a common way to point at a button), and the other effects should either do something sensible or not be offered on a spotlight.
notes: Found finishing a-spotlight-dims-and-blurs-everything-except-the (2026-11-20). The spotlight takes its own path in DocumentRenderer.compositeLayers (spotlightVeil, SpotlightFilter) and `continue`s before the box-sized styling path, so borderEffects, castShadows and blurred never run for it. Reproduced with a throwaway render test: a spotlight with style.borderWidth = 6, borderColorHex #FF0000 (layer.ringedBorders.count == 1) renders [255,255,255,255] at the area edge (61,100), identical to the same spotlight without a border. Only Opacity, Blending and Corner Radius apply today.
acceptance: Adding a Border to a spotlight draws a ring round its lit area, following its rounded corners or its ellipse, in light and dark pictures.
Shadow and Blur in Effects either draw something a person can see on a spotlight or are not offered for one.
A render test proves the ring is drawn and the lit area inside it is still pixel-identical to the picture.
